confirm.delete_package_description: Remove “{name}” with all its files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted; finished files stay in the destination folder.

confirm.delete_packages_label: Delete {count} packages | Delete {count} package | Delete {count} packages
confirm.remove_files_description: Remove {count} files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted. | Remove {count} file from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted. | Remove {count} files from the download list? Active downloads are cancelled and incomplete files deleted.
confirm.clear_completed: Really remove every package whose files have all finished? A package that is still working is left untouched, and finished files stay in the destination folder.
confirm.clear_failed: Really remove every finished package that contains a failed file, including its incomplete files? A package that is still working is left untouched.
confirm.clear_all: Really remove every package that has stopped working, whatever the outcome? A package with running, waiting or seeding files is left untouched, and finished files stay in the destination folder.
confirm.remove_download_completed: Remove the entry from the download list? The finished file is kept.
confirm.remove_download_partial: Remove the entry from the download list? An existing incomplete file is deleted as well.
confirm.delete_package_active: “{name}” is still working. Remove it anyway? Its running downloads are cancelled and their incomplete files deleted; finished files stay in the destination folder.
confirm.delete_packages_active: Remove {count} package(s), {busy} of which are still working? Running downloads are cancelled and their incomplete files deleted; finished files stay in the destination folder.
